Behind the table, a fluted cream sideboard with vertical reeded panels sits against the wall, topped with a small stack of books. In the left corner, a potted olive tree in a simple white ceramic pot adds a lush living green element. The window to the far left is dressed with sheer linen curtains allowing warm diffused light to enter from outside. A large natural jute rug grounds the dining set.
